properties.name: dbmcp.database.url
properties.description: JDBC URL shared by read and write tools: jdbc:mysql:, jdbc:oracle:, jdbc:sqlserver:, jdbc:postgresql:, or jdbc:starrocks:.

properties.name: dbmcp.database.username
properties.description: Database account shared by read and write tools; use a least-privilege account.

properties.name: dbmcp.database.schema
properties.description: Optional metadata schema (Oracle owner, SQL Server/PostgreSQL schema, StarRocks database). Defaults to the connection's current schema. Does not change SQL name resolution; qualify SQL objects explicitly. MySQL uses the database in its URL.

properties.name: dbmcp.database.min-idle
properties.description: Minimum number of idle HikariCP connections to keep in the pool.

properties.name: dbmcp.database.connection-timeout
properties.description: Milliseconds to wait for a free connection before failing.

properties.name: dbmcp.query.max-rows
properties.description: Maximum number of rows db_query returns per call.

properties.name: dbmcp.query.timeout-seconds
properties.description: SQL statement timeout in seconds, shared by SELECT and DML/DDL.

properties.name: dbmcp.query.max-cell-chars
properties.description: Maximum characters per returned cell; longer values are truncated.

properties.name: dbmcp.write.allow-ddl
properties.description: DDL tool switch; when false, db_execute_ddl rejects execution while DML stays available.

properties.name: dbmcp.redis.max-databases
properties.description: Number of databases redis_select_db may switch between; valid indexes are 0 to this value minus one.

properties.name: dbmcp.redis.max-scan-count
properties.description: Upper bound for the COUNT hint of redis_scan_keys.

properties.name: dbmcp.redis.max-items
properties.description: Maximum number of elements per Redis read, write, or delete call.

properties.name: dbmcp.redis.max-value-chars
properties.description: Maximum characters per Redis value; reads truncate and writes reject longer values.
